categories.label: Request a code change
categories.description: A request to change the implementation or development workflow.
categories.action: Add automated linting, static analysis, architecture checks, and clear coding standards before PR creation.

categories.label: Point out a bug
categories.action: Run automated tests, type checks, edge-case tests, and local/CI validation before opening the PR.

categories.label: Raise a security concern
categories.action: Add automated security scanning, dependency checks, secret detection, and secure coding rules to CI.

categories.label: Question performance or scalability
categories.description: An inefficient implementation or scalability risk.
categories.action: Add benchmarks, performance tests, query analysis, and predefined performance constraints for critical paths.

categories.label: Correctness
categories.description: An edge case, logic error, or data-integrity issue.
categories.action: Correct the behavior and add coverage for the affected case.

categories.label: Suggest an improvement
categories.description: A readability, structure, duplication, or technical-debt concern.
categories.action: Use shared design patterns, reusable components, code templates, and pre-PR self-review checklists.

categories.label: Request or discuss tests
categories.description: Missing, weak, or incorrect automated coverage.
categories.action: Define minimum test expectations and automatically check coverage and required test scenarios in CI.

categories.label: Share context or knowledge
categories.description: Missing or inaccurate documentation or code comments.
categories.action: Document architectural decisions, link relevant tickets/docs in the PR, and maintain lightweight ADRs for important decisions.

categories.label: Flag a style or convention issue
categories.description: A formatting or low-risk convention issue.
categories.action: Enforce formatting, naming, and style rules automatically with linters, formatters, and pre-commit hooks.

categories.label: Ask for clarification
categories.description: A request for clarification or an unresolved design decision.
categories.action: Require clear ticket acceptance criteria, PR descriptions, and inline documentation for non-obvious logic.

categories.label: Give approval or positive feedback
categories.description: Positive feedback without a requested code change.
categories.action: Automate routine validation so reviewers can focus on meaningful design decisions and approve low-risk PRs faster.

categories.label: Other
categories.description: Feedback that does not fit a defined category.
categories.action: Triage manually and agree on the appropriate next step.
